content.text_value: Seven steps to start or accelerate the AI-first journey

steps.label: Set the ambition and tone from the top
steps.body: CEO sponsorship, a board mandate, a three-year target and a protected budget.

steps.label: Pick two or three workflows and go all-in
steps.body: Research and distribution carry the highest impact; redesign them end to end.

steps.label: Invest in activation along with technology
steps.body: Build literacy from the C-suite to analysts: prompting, verification, collaboration.

steps.label: Fix the data agents need
steps.body: Make the data behind each workflow clean and connected so outputs are reliable.

steps.label: Build governance in from day one
steps.body: Senior committee, auditable agent design, human-in-the-loop boundaries.

steps.label: Tie AI outcomes to incentives
steps.body: If it is not in a scorecard or review it will not happen at scale.

steps.label: Design the organization of the future
steps.body: Leaner teams where people oversee a broader scope of AI-supported workflows.
